children: Dogecoin is pressing against a key technical barrier after defending the $0.081 support zone, where a large concentration of DOGE has changed hands. The hourly chart now shows a bullish flag forming beneath $0.090, leaving traders focused on whether buyers can force a sustained breakout. A move above $0.090 would strengthen the setup and put $0.115 in focus, while the on-chain structure suggests a much larger resistance test could emerge if the breakout develops into a broader trend.
30 Billion DOGE Make $0.081 a Key Support Zone

The first signal comes from Dogecoin’s URPD data, which places roughly 30 billion DOGE around $0.081. That is a substantial concentration of previously transacted supply and gives the level greater significance than a purely technical support line. DOGE’s ability to remain above this cluster indicates that holders accumulated around the zone are not facing immediate supply pressure, while buyers continue to have a clearly defined area from which to defend the recent structure.

The same distribution profile also shows relatively less on-chain activity through the higher levels immediately above DOGE’s current range. If price breaks out and attracts fresh demand, the market may therefore move through the thinner supply area relatively quickly before encountering the larger historical concentration near $0.177.
Bullish Flag Puts $0.090 in the Spotlight
The second signal is coming directly from the hourly price structure. DOGE has been consolidating after its recent advance, with the pullback taking the shape of a bullish flag.

The pattern places $0.090 at the center of the setup. An hourly close above this resistance would provide the technical confirmation bulls need, particularly if the breakout is accompanied by stronger trading volume. From there, $0.115 becomes the immediate upside objective, representing roughly 28% above $0.090. A successful breakout-and-retest of $0.090 would strengthen the continuation case, while repeated rejection would keep DOGE locked inside the current range.

While the daily timeframe analysis indicates that Dogecoin price has retested the breakout region and is ready for a reversal. Recent upmove has faced rejection from the 200 day EMA and DOGE price faced retracement toward the neckline support zone of $0.8300. A confirmed close above the $0.9500 permit the bulls to chase the next target of $0.1000 followed by $0.1180.

As long as $0.081 holds, the bullish structure remains intact, with buyers repeatedly defending a zone backed by roughly 30 billion DOGE in transaction volume. The decisive test now sits at $0.090. A clean hourly close above that level, followed by a successful retest, would confirm the bullish flag and shift the near-term target toward $0.115, implying nearly 28% upside. If momentum persists beyond $0.115, the thinner on-chain supply above could allow DOGE to extend toward the larger $0.177 resistance zone. Conversely, a decisive break below $0.081 would invalidate the setup and put the bullish continuation thesis on hold.

title: DOGE Price Could Be Setting Up for a 28% Move as $0.081 Holds Firm
